what: How EdgeDesk's A–F Research Grades have held up on completed games. A grade measures the quality and reliability of the pregame research, not the chance a side wins. Research, not picks.

exclusions.no_pregame_grade_note: Completed games with no grade locked before kickoff (most started before the grade ledger began). They are never graded afterwards.

letters.A: Research is complete, current, cross-checked against a captured market line and backed by a validated live track record.
letters.B: Solid research with one or two gaps, or a track record still building.
letters.C: Usable research with clear gaps: an unvalidated track record, unknown availability or no market cross-check.
letters.D: Thin research: several inputs are missing, stale or uncertain.
letters.F: Weak research: most of what a reliable read needs is missing or uncertain.
letters.INSUFFICIENT: Not graded: a prerequisite failed (no model number, an expired or invalidated build, or too little data).

tooltip: Research Grade rates the quality and reliability of EdgeDesk's pregame research on this game: the model's track record, data completeness, a check against a sportsbook line, matchup clarity and uncertainty. It is not a win probability, not a prediction of who wins and not a betting recommendation. Research, not picks.
rules: A grade is computed only before kickoff, from what was on file at that moment, and locked in an append-only, hash-chained ledger. Every change is kept.
A game is judged by its latest valid pregame grade: the last one locked before the actual start. A grade made for a start that moved by more than 36 hours is not used.
No game is ever given a grade afterwards. Completed games with no pregame grade are counted and excluded, never backfilled.

Finals come from the performance ledger: sources must agree; canceled, forfeited and long-postponed games are void; overtime counts; NHL finals include the shootout goal; a corrected final is a new revision.
Against-the-spread and over/under records use only the side and the named-book line saved with the grade before kickoff. No side is ever chosen from the final.
Closing-line value appears only against a close from the same source family as the line the grade saw. No price is ever assumed.
A rate, Brier score or error is printed only from 20 settled games, an interval only from 50. Below that the counts are shown.
The weights are provisional. No grade is claimed to predict results until settled games show it, pair by pair, with intervals that exclude zero.
